title: Muting Tokens: Exploring Token Sparsification for Efficient Audio Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.31235v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transformer-based models have shown strong performance across diverse tasks, but their reliance on self-attention mechanisms often leads to high computational costs. Token sparsification, which reduces the number of tokens processed in transformer layers, offers a promising solution to maintain performance while improving efficiency. However, although widely studied in the vision and language domains, token sparsification remains underexplored in audio, with existing work often limited to a single method, model size, or dataset. This work presents a comprehensive evaluation of token sparsification techniques for audio transformers. We assess a range of token pruning and merging strategies across multiple datasets and model sizes, under both post-training and fine-tuning settings. Furthermore, we introduce a novel sparsification approach that combines attention scores with spectral cues derived from the frequency content of token embedd

translated_title: 静音令牌：探索用于高效音频Transformer的令牌稀疏化
translated_abstract: 基于Transformer的模型在多种任务中展现出强大的性能，但其对自注意力机制的依赖往往导致高昂的计算成本。令牌稀疏化通过减少Transformer层中所处理的令牌数量，提供了一种在保持性能的同时提升效率的有前景的解决方案。然而，尽管令牌稀疏化在视觉和语言领域已被广泛研究，它在音频领域仍探索不足，现有工作通常仅局限于单一方法、模型规模或数据集。本工作对音频Transformer的令牌稀疏化技术进行了全面评估。我们在多种数据集和模型规模上，于训练后和微调两种设置下，评估了一系列令牌剪枝与合并策略。此外，我们提出了一种新颖的稀疏化方法，该方法将注意力分数与从令牌嵌入的频率内容中提取的频谱线索相结合。
tldr: 本文对音频Transformer中的令牌稀疏化技术进行了全面评估，并提出了一种将注意力分数与频谱线索相结合的新型稀疏化方法，在多种数据集和模型规模下实现效率提升的同时保持性能。
